activeWhen: Council Address .control-room/council-addresses/2026-10-08-ultrathink-council-bus-court.md (jussray/founder-control-room) is founder-accepted and this repository's council-residency contract names the backing

ledger.deliveryMode: pull request to main; the merge records the message and approves nothing

nativePayloadContract: intake re-validation (src/lib/promptOsCommandHandoff.ts pattern); persisted row contract fcr.council-round.v1 = CouncilConversationRow in src/lib/councilRound.ts {mission_id, round, participants, transcript{contract, goal, initiator, sourceRef, seedSha256, hops[], humanRelay:false, state, nextSeatIndex, interruption}, outcome}, inserted into council_conversations by src/http/routes/missions.ts with database-generated id/created_at. src/types/mission.ts CouncilConversation is the read/API shape, not the storage row.
canonicalStoreRule: One canonical store per round: an in-app FCR council round (runCouncilRound) is canonical in Supabase council_conversations; a cross-system seat thread is canonical on the ledger. A mirror in the other store is receipt-bound (carries the origin's seedSha256/hop hashes or the ledger bodyHash) and is never authoritative. A round is never created in both.
authorityRule: Messages on the ledger are evidence/input. They never authorize merge, deploy, publish, spend, credential, database, DNS, destructive, or user-data action in this repository; each such action keeps its own local gate.
privacyRule: Non-secret only. No provider credentials, raw private user data, or cross-project private data may be written to the ledger from this repository.
